name: blender
description: Blender 3D scene creation, inspection, and manipulation via blender-mcp
hits: Blender (3D modeling, scenes, rendering via blender-mcp)
surface: MCP stdio server (`uvx blender-mcp`) connecting to Blender's socket on localhost:9876; scene/object inspection and viewport screenshots (read); arbitrary Blender Python execution and 3D modeling/assets (ungated write)

origin.note: the MCP server and Blender addon this connector configures

install.description: Install Blender 3D creation suite via Homebrew Cask
install.why: Blender must be present locally to open scenes and run the MCP server socket
install.no: skipped; install Blender manually from blender.org

install.description: Install MCP for Blender addon into Blender user addons directory
install.why: The addon provides the Blender-side socket server that blender-mcp communicates with
install.no: skipped; install the addon manually in Blender preferences

auth.flow: none — blender-mcp connects to Blender locally over loopback socket (localhost:9876); no cloud credentials required for local 3D operations

safeguards: No local gate is claimed: the belt ships no code on the call path, so it cannot enforce one. The server runs locally and communicates with Blender over a local loopback socket (localhost:9876) (SENSIBILITIES #13); the belt's contribution is registration, verb tiers, and the contract in CLAUDE.md (SENSIBILITIES #2).
Local-first: scene reads and Python execution happen inside the local Blender process; external asset downloads and generations (Poly Haven, Sketchfab, Hyper3D) are explicit network operations.

verbs.name: get_scene_info
verbs.note: returns objects, collections, camera, lights, materials, and units in the active Blender scene

verbs.name: get_object_info
verbs.note: detailed properties of a specific object (mesh data, modifiers, material slots, transforms)

verbs.name: get_viewport_screenshot
verbs.note: captures an image of the current 3D viewport

verbs.name: get_addon_status
verbs.note: reports addon version, connection health, and protocol compatibility

verbs.name: get_polyhaven_categories
verbs.note: lists categories of available assets on Poly Haven

verbs.name: search_polyhaven_assets
verbs.note: searches textures, models, or HDRIs on Poly Haven

verbs.name: get_polyhaven_status
verbs.note: checks connectivity to Poly Haven

verbs.name: get_sketchfab_status
verbs.note: checks Sketchfab API configuration and status

verbs.name: search_sketchfab_models
verbs.note: searches downloadable 3D models on Sketchfab

verbs.name: get_sketchfab_model_preview
verbs.note: fetches thumbnail/preview image for a Sketchfab model

verbs.name: get_polypizza_status
verbs.note: checks connectivity to Poly Pizza

verbs.name: search_polypizza_models
verbs.note: searches low-poly models on Poly Pizza

verbs.name: get_hyper3d_status
verbs.note: checks Hyper3D API key configuration

verbs.name: poll_rodin_job_status
verbs.note: checks status of an in-progress Hyper3D Rodin generation job

verbs.name: get_hunyuan3d_status
verbs.note: checks Hunyuan3D API key configuration

verbs.name: poll_hunyuan_job_status
verbs.note: checks status of an in-progress Hunyuan3D generation job

verbs.name: execute_blender_code
verbs.note: runs arbitrary Python code inside Blender with full bpy API access; ungated at the MCP layer — preview code before execution

verbs.name: set_texture
verbs.note: assigns and configures material textures on target mesh objects

verbs.name: download_polyhaven_asset
verbs.note: downloads CC0 asset from Poly Haven and imports it into the current scene

verbs.name: download_sketchfab_model
verbs.note: downloads and imports a model from Sketchfab into the current scene

verbs.name: download_polypizza_model
verbs.note: downloads and imports a low-poly model from Poly Pizza

verbs.name: generate_hyper3d_model_via_text
verbs.note: initiates a text-to-3D generation job on Hyper3D Rodin (paid API)

verbs.name: generate_hyper3d_model_via_images
verbs.note: initiates an image-to-3D generation job on Hyper3D Rodin (paid API)

verbs.name: import_generated_asset
verbs.note: imports a finished Hyper3D generated asset into the scene

verbs.name: import_generated_asset_hunyuan
verbs.note: imports a finished Hunyuan3D generated asset into the scene

verbs.name: record_trajectory_feedback
verbs.note: records trajectory ratings and feedback

verbs.name: disable_telemetry
verbs.note: turns off telemetry collection in blender-mcp

risk.worst_case: arbitrary Python execution in the operator's active Blender scene alters or deletes open models/scenes without an automatic undo; nothing leaves the host unless external model generation APIs are explicitly called
